raw.rationale: TCS-359 is a preclinical FLT3 inhibitor, and FLT3 dependency is largely restricted to hematologic malignancies, especially AML, which is not among the listed lineages; PRISM single-concentration screens rarely show lineage-selective killing for kinase inhibitors without a lineage-specific oncogenic dependency. Thus selective killing of any listed solid-tumor lineage is unlikely, with probabilities near the low end of the base-rate range.
